introduction: I went over the consent form for the laparoscopic cholecystectomy with Mr. Gonzalez. He will require 5 buttonhole incisions in the abdominal cavity. Start an IV because he will receive a dose of cephalosporin to decrease the risk of infection, and dexamethasone for systemic analgesia. Also, draw a Type and Cross match and have a unit of packed RBC’s on hand. Please have Mr. Gonzalez sign the consent form.

default_chat.Jay: Good morning, Mr. Gonzalez. I’m a registered nurse, and I am here to have you sign the consent form and get you ready for surgery. What did Jeremy tell you about your procedure?
default_chat.Ricardo_Gonzalez: He said he would poke some holes into my stomach and remove my gallbladder, but I don’t really get what he means. How will I be able to eat if I have holes in my stomach?

PA.ideal: Got it. Mr. Gonzalez is scheduled for a laparoscopic cholecystectomy involving five buttonhole incisions in the abdominal cavity. I’ll start an IV for cephalosporin to prevent infection and dexamethasone for the pain. I’ll draw a Type and Cross match and ensure a unit of packed RBCs is available. I’ll also have Mr. Gonzalez sign the consent form.
PA.ideal_reply: Great! I’ll be on my way. Have a nice day!
PA.ideal_reply2: The PA walks away and you enter Mr. Gonzalez’s hospital room.
